text:
elena: Quick sync: we keep getting questions from infra about how to attribute GPU/CPU cost when requests from multiple tenants are multiplexed into a shared batcher. Current traces show latency but not "who caused the batch". we need a lightweight provenance header that survives fanout and reassembly.
omar: this is hurting chargeback calculations. can we add a compact provenance token that encodes tenant_id, batch_shard, and a tiny weight heuristic? something like rbp (redwood-batch-provenance) base62 token to avoid high-cardinality headers.
elena: yep. goals: 1) enable low-effort postmortem joins (trace -> tenant) without exploding metrics cardinality 2) let rollup jobs attribute costs by model/route/tenant-weight 3) keep the header small and opt-out-able for private installs.
vishal: implementation sketch: edge computes provenance = encode({t:tenant_hash, s:shard, w:weight_bucket}) where weight_bucket approximates token-cost contribution (1..8). stamp as X-RW-RBP. propagate into root span attribute rw.rbp and into response structured logs.
nina: very important: never put raw tenant_id or user content in header. tenant_hash must be HMAC with key per-deployment. also document that weight_bucket is only an estimate for attribution, not billing-grade.
dave: on storage side: do NOT index rbp. instead run a nightly rollup that expands RBP into buckets and computes totals: rollup keys = {day, model, route, tenant_bucket, mode}. store rollups in batch_cost_rollup_{day}. This keeps trace store lean.
elena: we still need a fast diagnostic path for live incidents. propose a short-lived trace index for traces marked diagnostic=true; those traces can be searched by rbp for 72h then evicted. permitted by quota.
omar: sample pseudocode for edge: ```
prov = rbp_encode(tenant_hash(req.tenant), shard_for(req), weight_bucket_for(req))
req.headers.set("X-RW-RBP", prov)
span.root.set_tag("rw.rbp", prov)
metric.emit("rw.batcher.choice",1,{mode:batch.mode,model:req.model,route:req.route})
```
vishal: also add a per-route config: observability.provenance.enabled and provenance.sample_rate for whether to mark traces diagnostic. default: hosted enabled, sample_rate=0.01 for diagnostic indexing. private: disabled by default.
nina: privacy: make scrubber run on any sampled payload; provenance token is safe if HMACed. add migration note for customers who rotate keys.
dave: dashboards: build a derived tile that maps rollups -> unit-costs so product teams can see estimated GPU-seconds per tenant per model. warn about approximation in docs.
elena: next steps: 1) design compact rbp format & HMAC details (nina+vishal) 2) edge shim prototype in staging (omar) 3) rollup job + dashboard skeleton (dave) 4) RFC summary and defaults for hosted/private (elena). ETA 3 sprints?
omar: opening a small RFC and will include encoding examples + offramps.
